channel.title: Al-Jazeera Media Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Al-Jazeera Media Network (aljazeera.com)

item.title: Trump says lawmakers Ilhan Omar, Rashida Tlaib should be removed from US
item.description: US President Donald Trump lashed out at two congresswomen after their protests during his State of the Union address.

item.title: US to allow Venezuelan oil sales to Cuba as alarm grows in the Caribbean
item.description: US eases oil embargo on Cuba as Caribbean neighbours warn worsening humanitarian crisis could destabilise region.

item.title: North Korea’s Kim Jong Un warns South Korea, says US should end hostility
item.description: Kim emphasised that Pyongyang intends to cement its position on the global stage through its nuclear capabilities.

item.title: US-Iran talks live: Nuclear talks to kick off in Geneva amid tensions
item.description: Third round of indirect negotiations to take place amid a massive US military build-up in the Middle East.

item.title: Hong Kong appeals court overturns Jimmy Lai’s fraud conviction
item.description: Surprise ruling comes weeks after the media mogul was convicted and jailed for 20 years on national security charges.

item.title: UK far-right activist Tommy Robinson talks up US State Department visit
item.description: Robinson is notorious in the UK where he has been accused of promoting hatred against Muslims and migrants.

item.title: Ramadan in Iraq’s Mosul: Living traditions between past and present
item.description: Mosul revives Ramadan traditions, markets and storytelling as worship, games and charity return after years of war.

item.title: How higher gold prices are affecting zakat calculations this Ramadan
item.description: Zakat is an obligatory charity in Islam, intended to purify wealth and promote economic equality.

item.title: Syria confirms ‘mass escape’ from camp housing relatives of ISIL fighters
item.description: Official says relatives of ISIL escaped from al-Hol following the SDF's withdrawal from the camp last month.

item.title: US, Ukraine to meet in Geneva as Russia attacks Kyiv with missiles, drones
item.description: Kyiv hopes progress in talks in Geneva will pave the way for a direct meeting between Russian and Ukrainian leaders.
